# PR-body permalink and diff-link rendering, re-pin after force-push

Status: needs-triage
Type: task
Source: moor-95 retro, 2026-10-12 (rank 4)

## Problem

Every PR body needs a filename-labelled blob permalink plus a diff link for each file. moor-95's current routine:
1. Compute sha256(path) diff anchors by hand.
2. Use a PRNUM placeholder and create the PR.
3. sed the real PR URL in, then edit the PR.
4. Re-pin every SHA by hand after each rebase.

## Request

A human-layer helper that renders `[file](path#Lx-Ly)` into a permalink plus a diff link from the PR number and head SHA, and re-pins after a force-push.

## Overlap

src/review/pr-links.ts already exists (commit 69956018): `pr-links.ts <file> --repo <owner/name> --pr <N> [--sha <sha>]` appends sha256 `#diff-` anchors to GitHub blob links. Still missing:
- rendering from a bare `path#Lx-Ly`
- re-pinning existing blob SHAs to a new head after a force-push
- discoverability: moor-95 did not know the tool exists, so the human-layer skill should point to it

## Comments

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

2026-10-12, moor-b7: the writer hand-copied a commit sha with a 1-character typo (5120ee56eeb0… vs 5120ee56aeb0…) into all 9 blob permalinks. Neither human-doc-check nor pr-links.ts caught it. When `--sha` is given, pr-links must fail on any `blob/<sha>` that differs from `--sha`, or rewrite it. This fits the `--repin` work.
